review_scope: Directory curation against retained repository sources; not a new provider audit or fresh live verification.

providers.name: ACI gateway (RedPill / Phala)
checks: Selected gateway quote, event-log, compose and keyset bindings; measured hostname policy.
delegates: TDX appraisal uses the pinned NEAR verifier dependency in data/instrument.json.
unchecked: Expected boot-register policy, downstream session closure and a complete encrypted request.

providers.name: NEAR AI
checks: Selected TDX/GPU/key/compose checks, per-model anchor comparison and recorded on-chain authorization queries.
delegates: External quote/GPU appraisal and Base authorization; an authorization is provider policy.
unchecked: Authenticated compose-manager closure and request/reply/model binding; the lightclient is diagnostic and cannot complete an encrypted request.

providers.name: Tinfoil
checks: Release provenance, release/report measurement agreement, selected TLS/HPKE key and runtime configuration checks.
delegates: Sigstore release verification; router trust policy for downstream workers.
unchecked: AMD report signature-chain verification, independent build reproduction and a live worker request.

providers.name: Venice
checks: Backend-shaped attestation reports for sampled Venice model routes.
delegates: Backend-specific checks; NEAR and Phala routes require different evidence.
unchecked: A complete request-bound model/key proof and shipped-client enforcement; reachable evidence alone is insufficient.

providers.name: Chutes
checks: Selected TDX, nonce and worker-key checks and base-image MRTD observations. GPU evidence presence is recorded without appraisal.
delegates: External TDX appraisal; provider golden measurements are not independent workload approval.
unchecked: GPU evidence is not appraised by this adapter. Serving code and weights are outside measured registers; ordinary API and opt-in encrypted paths differ.

providers.name: Maple
checks: Inspected SDK source checks Nitro document, nonce, certificate chain, signature and PCR policy before session use. Repository captures PCR publications and SDK policy bytes.
delegates: AWS Nitro roots and SDK PCR history policy; Tinfoil or Continuum/Privatemode onward verification.
unchecked: No repository live Nitro adapter, independent EIF reproduction, shipped-client mapping or selected downstream request proof.

providers.name: Private Inference

implementations.status: captured deployed browser verifier; source-inspected only

checks: Captured browser code performs selected quote/compose/GPU self-consistency checks and encryption. Repository captures browser/catalog bytes.
delegates: NEAR worker evidence and browser delivery; standard and ZDR routes have separate plaintext boundaries.
unchecked: No approved compose/OS baseline seen in inspected browser; no repository live verifier or authenticated completion; reply-key substitution remains a dated finding.

providers.name: Privatemode
checks: Repository captures the published workload manifest. Linked proxy/SDK verification is a documented lead.
delegates: Provider manifest and selected proxy update policy; a pinned manifest differs from automatic adoption.
unchecked: No repository live hardware/session verifier; manifest signatures, workloads, GPU/model roots and proxyless path remain unproven here.

providers.name: Confidential AI Inference
checks: Repository captures allowlist/release publications. Linked verifier/TEErminator procedures are documented leads.
delegates: Published release identity, allowlist, TDX workload policy and same-channel TLS pinning require separate verification.
unchecked: No repository live signature/receipt/channel verifier or completion; source-documented operator-control exclusions remain unresolved.
